tools.name: list_diary_entries
tools.title: List diary entries
tools.description: List the signed-in user's wine diary entries (or wishlist items), newest first. Optionally filter by a search term matching the wine name or producer.

status.description: 'tasted' for diary entries, 'interested' for wishlist items. Defaults to tasted.

search.description: Text to match against wine name or producer.

limit.description: How many entries to return (1-100, default 20).

tools.name: get_taste_profile
tools.title: Get taste profile
tools.description: Get the signed-in user's taste profile: how many wines they've logged, their top grapes and countries, red/white split, and average alcohol and vintage age.

tools.name: add_to_wishlist
tools.title: Add a wine to the wishlist
tools.description: Add a wine the user wants to try to their Wine Diary wishlist. Reuses an existing catalogue wine when the name and producer already match.

name.description: Wine name as written on the label or wine list.

notes.description: Why the user wants to try it, or where they saw it.

tools.name: list_menu_scans
tools.title: List scanned wine lists
tools.description: List the restaurant wine lists the signed-in user has scanned, newest first, with venue and location details.

limit.description: How many scans to return (1-50, default 10).

tools.name: get_menu_scan
tools.title: Get a scanned wine list
tools.description: Get every wine parsed from one of the signed-in user's scanned restaurant wine lists, with prices, section headings and any diary matches.

menu_scan_id.description: The id of the menu scan, from list_menu_scans.
